item.title: Report: GTA 6 Gameplay Shown in New South Park Episode, RockstarINTEL Reports
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that official Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay aired during a new South Park episode, featuring Jason and Lucia in Vice City and a beach scene with dense NPCs.

item.title: Rockstar Games Pays About $3.9 Million for GTA 6 Miami Marketing Deal
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports Rockstar Games and Miami-Dade County finalized a roughly $3.9 million GTA 6 marketing agreement for Vice City branding at Miami International Airport, PortMiami, and county traffic cabinets.

item.description: Rockstar Games UK staff are set to vote on union recognition during the GTA 6 launch, with voting scheduled from November 12 to 26.

item.title: GTA 6 Early Review Access Confirmed by Rockstar Insider
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that review codes for Grand Theft Auto VI have been distributed to reviewers, with public reviews scheduled for November 18th, one day before launch.

item.title: Report: GTA 6: Gameplay, Trailers, Features & Everything We Know (Updated October 2026)
item.description: Beebom published an updated October 2026 overview of Grand Theft Auto 6 covering gameplay, trailers, and features. The RSS listing does not include specific article details.

item.title: Report: PureGym Shares Thumb Workouts to Prepare for GTA VI Launch
item.description: GameSpot reports PureGym shared three thumb exercises from trainer David Hope to help players warm up before Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, alongside related launch-day projections and themed food at Miami's Kaseya Center.

item.title: Report: GTA 6’s New TV Trailer Is A Bit Different, See It For Yourself
item.description: Gamespot details new GTA 6 TV commercial variations, including removed shower scenes, extended airplane shots, Xbox logo removal, and real-life restaurant tie-ins ahead of launch.

item.title: GTA 6 Worker Absenteeism Study Estimates Paid Leave Day, RockstarINTEL
item.description: A Uswitch study of 1,000 British gamers estimates nearly 34.5 million UK employees will skip work on Nov. 19.

item.title: How To Get The GTA Online UFO Rewards 2026
item.description: Guide to obtaining the Shocker weapon and Gray Space Interloper outfit during the 2026 UFO event week in GTA Online.

item.title: Extended GTA 6 Launch Trailer Airing on TV
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports an extended cut of the GTA 6 launch trailer aired on TV during an NBA broadcast.

item.title: Report: Rockstar Releases Three Beer Brands Based on GTA 6 Game Content
item.description: Rockstar is reportedly launching three new beer brands—Pißwasser, Patriot, and No Mames Vice City—produced by Tripping Animals Brewing, with alcohol strengths ranging from 4.2% to 6% ABV.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Pre‑orders Outpace Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 by 148%
item.description: GTA 6 preorders are outpacing Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 by 148% ahead of launch, according to Sensor Tower data reported by Gamespot.

item.description: British actor Rahul Kohli pitches a multi-period L.A. Noire spinoff, while Take-Two explores future projects in the franchise and a new rumor hints at a Zodiac Killer-focused game.

item.title: Report: Citi Bank Predicts New Red Dead Game Could Launch by 2027-2028
item.description: Investment bank Citi says a new Red Dead title could arrive in 2027 or 2028, but Rockstar's development cycle may make that timeline unrealistic.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Leaker 'Cyberleek' Quits After Meme Coin Crash, Ending at Risk via Dead Man’s Switch
item.description: Credible RockstarINTEL reports that the notorious GTA 6 leaker 'Cyberleek' has ceased sharing content following a failed meme coin venture, leaving fans worried about unverified claims of a dead man’s switch protecting the game's ending.

item.description: GameRant reports that Rockstar Games has deployed real-world vehicles modded to resemble Grand Theft Auto 6 cars on the streets of Miami as part of the game's marketing campaign. item.title: New GTA 6 Screenshot and Launch Trailer Artwork Released
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports a brand new GTA 6 screenshot and launch trailer artwork featuring protagonists Jason and Lucia, confirming the November 19, 2026 release date.

item.title: Report: RockstarINTEL Reports Claimed Final GTA 6 Leak Includes Ending Snippet as Leaker Quits
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports a claimed final GTA 6 leak includes an ending snippet as the leaker says he is quitting; all claims are attributed to the outlet and treated as unverified.

item.title: Rockstar Says GTA 6 Will Speed Up Future Game Development
item.description: Rockstar says GTA 6's development tools and team will let them build the next game faster, cutting the typical eight‑year wait.

item.title: New GTA 6 Screenshots Revealed via Bloomberg Interview
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports two new official GTA 6 screenshots shared by Bloomberg after Jason Schreier’s interview with Rockstar North staff, showing Lucia in mud and a fresh Pegassi model.

item.title: GTA 6 PC Port Could Arrive Within Three Months of Console Launch
item.description: GameSpot reports that Rockstar Games may release Grand Theft Auto 6 on PC in early 2027, just a few months after its planned November 2026 console debut.

item.title: New GTA 6 Merch Released Alongside Art Museum Exhibition
item.description: Rockstar releases new GTA 6 merchandise and partners with Wynwood Walls Museum for a Stockyard-themed exhibition, featuring artwork from over a dozen artists.

item.title: GTA 6 Boxed Copies Sold Out At Some Retailers
item.description: GTA 6 physical editions are selling out ahead of the November 12 release, with Amazon US and Target reporting sold‑out pre‑orders as Rockstar maintains limited quantities.
